Interface PlatformTerminal

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
UnixTerminal, WindowsTerminal
public interface PlatformTerminal extends AutoCloseable
Platform-independent terminal operations interface.

This interface abstracts the low-level terminal operations that differ between Unix (Linux/macOS) and Windows platforms.

  • Method Details

    • enableRawMode

      void enableRawMode() throws IOException
      Enables raw mode on the terminal.

      Raw mode disables line buffering, echo, and special character processing, allowing direct character-by-character input.

      Throws:
      IOException - if raw mode cannot be enabled

    • disableRawMode

      Disables raw mode and restores original terminal attributes.
      Throws:
      IOException - if raw mode cannot be disabled

      Reads a single character from the terminal with timeout.

    • write

      void write(byte[] buffer, int offset, int length) throws IOException
      Writes a portion of a byte array to the terminal.

      This method allows writing from a reusable buffer without creating intermediate byte array copies.

      Parameters:
      buffer - the byte array containing data
      offset - the start offset in the buffer
      length - the number of bytes to write
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing fails
